chunks: The salat is of three thirds — a third being purity, a third being ruku, and a third being sujud.

key_terms.رُكُوعٌ: ruku — the bowing posture in salat where the worshipper bends forward with hands on knees
key_terms.سُجُودٌ: sujud — the prostration posture where the forehead touches the ground in submission to God
key_terms.طَهُورٌ: taharah (ritual purity) — the prerequisite state of cleanliness required before prayer, including wudu

ai.seo_question: What are the three essential components of salat according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) describes the structure of salat as composed of three equal portions: ritual purity (taharah), ruku (bowing), and sujud (prostration). This tripartite teaching emphasizes that each of these three elements is foundational — none can be neglected without compromising the prayer's validity. The original audience of Imam al-Sadiq's students would have understood this as a normative legal ruling delineating the essential components of valid prayer, with taharah encompassing the prerequisite purification acts before prayer.
